author: Mike wagnitz
text: Very happy with service provided by Eagle Septic. Work was scheduled quickly and great follow up by the technician. Would highly recommend

author: Jenny Lanigan
text: Mason did a great job, he pumped out our septic system. He dug put the dirt to get at the septic and refilled where he had to dig. It was a clean job, we were very satisfied with his work.

author: Jack McGraw
text:
Mason was friendly and knowledgeable. We discussed the improved newer system filters.
I have been using Eagle Septic for years and have always gotten excellent service and response from the company and their professional employees.

author: Monica Robertson
text: Eagle Septic was extremely helpful with our septic service.   We are very pleased with their expertise and service, and we look forward to working them for years to come to keep our septic working properly!   Super friendly, professional and helpful.

author: RaeAnn Diamond
text: Eagle Septic did our septic pumping and maintenance check this past summer.  From the first phone call, they were courteous and prompt with their service.  They handled all the follow up with the county for submitting our required maintenance card, and really made the process easy for us from start to finish.
